about: The Workbench icons of the Rott drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/rott.svg, drawn as an OS 3.5 GlowIcon: shaped, shaded, see-through round the edges) is The AmiCradle Team's own, under the same terms as the other Amiga files; art/rott.png is it rendered at 128 x 128. Rott-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, Rott.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's Rott.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for ReadMe-taradino, COPYING.txt, Licences.txt and Cheats.txt.
